parsed.note_claim: Papua New Guinea has no president and is led by Prime Minister James Marape.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: The prime minister of the Independent State of Papua New Guinea is Papua New Guinea 's head of government , elected by the National Parliament and formally appointed by the Governor-General of Papua New Guinea .
parsed.reason: The page establishes that PNG's head of government is the Prime Minister, with James Marape as incumbent since 30 May 2019, and that the head of state is the monarch (Charles III) represented by a Governor-General, so there is no president.
